name: Berserk
description:
Go Berserk for 15 sec. While Berserk:

Generate 1 combo point every 1.5 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate 1 additional combo point. Finishing moves restore up to 3 combo points generated over the cap.

All attack and ability damage is increased by 15%.

name: Innervate
description: Infuse a friendly healer with energy, causing them to regenerate 25% of their maximum mana over 8 sec.

name: Heart of the Wild
description:
Perform a powerful off-role ability depending on your currently active shapeshift form.

Non-shapeshifted:
Empowered Wild Growth that heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 9,773 over 7 sec.

Bear Form:
Increase your maximum health by 30% for 20 sec.

name: Stampeding Roar
description: Shift into Bear Form and let loose a wild roar, increasing the movement speed of all friendly players within 15 yards by 60% for 8 sec.

name: Feral Frenzy
description: Unleash a furious frenzy, clawing your target 5 times for 29 Physical damage and an additional 192 Bleed damage over 6 sec.\n\nAwards 5 combo points.

name: Maim
description:
Finishing move that causes Physical damage and stuns the target. Damage and duration increased per combo point:

   1 point  : 5 damage, 1 sec
   2 points: 10 damage, 2 sec
   3 points: 15 damage, 3 sec
   4 points: 20 damage, 4 sec
   5 points: 25 damage, 5 sec

name: Tiger's Fury
description: Instantly restores 50 Energy, and increases the damage of all your attacks by 15% for their full duration. Lasts 10 sec.

name: Typhoon
description: Blasts targets within 15 yards in front of you with a violent Typhoon, knocking them back and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 6 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Skull Bash
description: You charge and bash the target's skull, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Starsurge
description: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 803 Astral damage.

name: Wild Growth
description: Heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 1,303 over 7 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

name: Remove Corruption
description: Nullifies corrupting effects on the friendly target, removing all Curse and Poison effects.

name: Survival Instincts
description: Reduces all damage you take by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Frenzied Regeneration
description: Heals you for 32% health over 3 sec.

name: Ironfur
description: Increases armor by 124 for 7 sec.

name: Hibernate
description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

name: Moonkin Form
description: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing the damage of your spells by 10% and your armor by 125%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Primal Wrath
description:
Finishing move that deals instant damage and applies Rip to all enemies within 10 yards. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 11 plus Rip for 4 sec
   2 points: 16 plus Rip for 6 sec
   3 points: 21 plus Rip for 8 sec
   4 points: 27 plus Rip for 10 sec
   5 points: 32 plus Rip for 12 sec

name: Rake
description: Rake the target for 10 Bleed damage and an additional 57 Bleed damage over 15 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Rejuvenation
description: Heals the target for 1,672 over 12 sec.

name: Rip
description:
Finishing move that causes Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 8 over 1 sec
   2 points: 12 over 2 sec
   3 points: 16 over 3 sec
   4 points: 20 over 3 sec
   5 points: 24 over 4 sec

name: Starfire
description: Call down a burst of energy, causing 352 Arcane damage to the target, and 243 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Sunfire
description: A quick beam of solar light burns the enemy for 80 Nature damage and then an additional 705 Nature damage over 18 sec.

name: Swipe
description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting Physical damage. Damage varies by shapeshift form.

name: Symbiotic Relationship
description: Form a bond with an ally. Your self-healing also heals your bonded ally for 10% of the amount healed. Your healing to your bonded ally also heals you for 8% of the amount healed.

name: Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane
description: An improved Cat Form that grants all of your known Berserk effects and lasts 20 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this improved Cat Form for its duration. During Incarnation:\n\nEnergy cost of all Cat Form abilities is reduced by 25%, and Prowl can be used once while in combat.

name: Convoke the Spirits
description: Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec.\n\nYou will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.

name: Mighty Bash
description: Invokes the spirit of Ursoc to stun the target for 4 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Ursol's Vortex
description: Conjures a vortex of wind for 10 sec at the destination, reducing the movement speed of all enemies within 8 yards by 50%. The first time an enemy attempts to leave the vortex, winds will pull that enemy back to its center. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Frantic Frenzy
description: Unleash a furious frenzy, flickering to nearby targets in front of you 5 times and clawing all enemies around them for 5 Physical damage and an additional 37 Bleed damage over 6 sec.\n\nAwards 5 combo points.

name: Tiger Dash
description: Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 200%, reducing gradually over 5 sec.

name: Incapacitating Roar
description: Shift into Bear Form and invoke the spirit of Ursol to let loose a deafening roar, incapacitating all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Mass Entanglement
description: Roots the target and all enemies within 12 yards in place for 10 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Chomp
description: Chomp your target, causing 412 Physical damage. Chomp critical strikes deal 3 times normal damage.\n\nChomp can only be used when you fall below 30% Energy or for 2 seconds afterward.

name: Wild Charge
description: Fly to a nearby ally's position.

name: Soothe
description: Soothes the target, dispelling all enrage effects.

name: Cyclone
description: Tosses the enemy target into the air, disorienting them but making them invulnerable for up to 5 sec. Only one target can be affected by your Cyclone at a time.

name: Rebirth
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 100% health and at least 20% mana. Castable in combat.

name: Dash
description: Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 60% while in Cat Form for 10 sec.

name: Essence of G'Hanir
description: Release the natural power within G'Hanir to increase the frequency that all of your heal over time effects heal allies by 100% for 8 sec.

name: Ashamane's Frenzy
description: Unleash Ashamane's Frenzy, clawing your target 15 times over 3 sec for 27 Physical damage and an additional 81 Bleed damage over 6 sec.\n\nAwards 3 combo points.

name: Barkskin
description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark, reducing all damage you take by 20% and preventing damage from delaying your spellcasts. Lasts 8 sec.\n\nUsable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared, or asleep, and in all shapeshift forms.

name: Dreamwalk
description: Teleports the caster to the Emerald Dreamway.\n\nCasting Dreamwalk again while in the Emerald Dreamway will return you back to near your departure point.

name: Charm Woodland Creature
description: Allows the Druid to befriend an ambient creature, which will follow the Druid for 1 hour.

name: Growl
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Prowl
description: Allows the Druid to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode.  Lasts until cancelled.

name: Thrash
description: Strikes all nearby enemies, dealing 34 Bleed damage and an additional 12 Bleed damage over 15 sec. When applied from Bear Form, this effect can stack up to 3 times.\n\nGenerates 5 Rage.

name: Strength of the Wild
description: Maul the target for 8% of the target's maximum health in Physical damage.

name: Track Beasts
description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.

name: Track Humanoids
description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.

name: Bear Form
description: Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor by 220% and Stamina by 25%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and increasing threat generation.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Cat Form
description: Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing auto-attack damage by 40%, movement speed by 30%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and reducing falling damage.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Cenarion Ward
description: Heals the target for 504.3 every 1.8 sec for 8 sec.

name: Clearcasting
description: Your healing over time from Lifebloom has a 4% chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Regrowth cost no mana.

name: Efflorescence
description: Restores 225 health to three injured allies within 10 yards of the initial target every 1.8 sec for 30 sec.

name: Entangling Roots
description: Roots the target in place for 30 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Ferocious Bite
description:
Finishing move that causes Physical damage per combo point and consumes up to 25 additional Energy to increase damage by up to 100%.

   1 point  : 9 damage
   2 points: 18 damage
   3 points: 27 damage
   4 points: 37 damage
   5 points: 46 damage

name: Flap
description: You flap your wings, slowing your falling speed.

name: Flight Form
description: Shapeshift into flight form, increasing movement speed and allowing you to fly. Cannot use in combat. \n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement impairing effects.

name: Mangle
description: Mangle the target for 68 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 12 Rage.

name: Mark of the Wild
description: Infuse a friendly target with the power of the wild, increasing their Versatility by 3% for 60 minutes.\n\nIf target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Moonfire
description: A quick beam of lunar light burns the enemy for 81 Arcane damage and then an additional 705 Arcane damage over 18 sec.

name: Mount Form
description: Shapeshift into a mountable ground travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only usable outdoors.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement impairing effects.

name: Regrowth
description: Heals a friendly target for 1,997 and another 287 over 6 sec.

name: Revive
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Not castable in combat.

name: Shred
description: Shred the target, causing 82 Physical damage to the target.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Teleport: Moonglade
description: Teleport to the Moonglade.\n\nCasting Teleport: Moonglade while in Moonglade will return you back to near your departure point.

name: Tranquility
description: Heals all allies within 40 yards for 19,557 over 5.4 sec. Healing decreased beyond 5 targets.\n\nRoots form around you while channeling, absorbing up to 60% of your health in damage and preventing knockbacks.

name: Travel Form
description: Shapeshift into a travel form appropriate to your current location, increasing movement speed on land, in water, or in the air, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Treant Form
description: Shapeshift into Treant Form.

name: Wrath
description: Hurl a ball of energy at the target, dealing 232 Nature damage.

name: Ysera's Gift
description: Heals you for 3% of your maximum health every 5 sec. If you are at full health, an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.

name: Ferocious Wound
description: Attacking with a 5 combo point Ferocious Bite reduces the target's maximum health by up to 3% for 30 sec, stacking up to 2 times. Ferocious Wound can only be active on one target at once.

name: Freedom of the Herd
description: Your Stampeding Roar clears all roots and snares from yourself and allies.

name: Fresh Wound
description: Rake has a 100% increased critical strike chance if used on a target that doesn’t already have Rake active.

name: High Winds
description: Increases the range of Cyclone, Typhoon, and Entangling Roots by 5 yds.

name: Leader of the Pack
description: While in Cat Form, you increase the movement speed of raid members within 20 yards by 10%.\n\nLeader of the Pack also causes allies to heal themselves for 3% of their maximum health when they critically hit with a direct attack. The healing effect cannot occur more than once every 8 sec.

name: Malorne's Swiftness
description: Your Travel Form movement speed while within a Battleground or Arena is increased by 20% and you always move at 100% movement speed while in Travel Form.

name: Savage Momentum
description: Interrupting a spell with Skull Bash reduces the remaining cooldown of Tiger's Fury, Survival Instincts, and Dash by 10 sec.

name: Thorns
description: Casting Barkskin sprouts thorns on you for 12 sec. When victim to melee attacks, thorns deals 433 Nature damage back to the attacker.\n\nAttackers also have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 4 sec.

name: Tireless Pursuit
description: For 3 sec after leaving Cat Form or Travel Form, you retain up to 25% movement speed.

name: Wicked Claws
description: Infected Wounds can now stack up to 2 times, and reduces 8% of all healing received by the target per stack.\n\nInfected Wounds can now also be applied from Rip.

name: Aessina's Renewal
description: When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.\n\nThis effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.

name: Aggravate Wounds
description: Every attack with an Energy cost that you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec.

name: Apex Predator's Craving
description: Rip damage has a 4.0% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite free and deal the maximum damage.

name: Ashamane's Guidance
description:
Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane
Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

 Convoke the Spirits
Convoke the Spirits' cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.

name: Astral Influence
description: Increases the range of all of your spells by 5 yards.

name: Berserk: Heart of the Lion
description: Reduces the cooldown of Berserk by 60 sec.

name: Bestial Strength
description: Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.

name: Blood Spattered
description: Ferocious Bite's damage to its primary target increased by 8% for each enemy affected by your Rip, up to 6.

name: Bond with Nature
description: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.

name: Bursting Growth
description: When Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing 30 physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.\n\nWhen Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for 163.

name: Carnivorous Instinct
description: Tiger's Fury's damage bonus is increased by 6%.

name: Circle of Life and Death
description: Your damage over time effects deal their damage in 20% less time, and your healing over time effects in 15% less time.

name: Circle of the Heavens
description: Magical damage dealt by your spells increased by 5%.

name: Circle of the Wild
description: Physical damage dealt by your abilities increased by 5%.

name: Claw Rampage
description: During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

name: Coiled to Spring
description: If you generate a combo point in excess of what you can store, your next Ferocious Bite or Primal Wrath deals 10% increased direct damage.

name: Double-Clawed Rake
description: Rake also applies Rake to 1 additional nearby target.

name: Dreadful Bleeding
description: Rip damage increased by 20%.

name: Dreadful Wound
description: Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes 35 damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.\n\nDreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death.

name: Empowered Shapeshifting
description:
Frenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and Swipe damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.

name: Entangling Vortex
description: Enemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Exacerbating Wounds
description: Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 15%.

name: Feline Swiftness
description: Increases your movement speed by 15%.

name: Flower Walk
description: During Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for 76.

name: Fluid Form
description:
Shred, Rake, and Skull Bash can be used in any form and shift you into Cat Form, if necessary. 

Mangle can be used in any form and shifts you into Bear Form. 

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.

name: Focused Frenzy
description: Feral Frenzy's cooldown reduced by 15 sec and its damage is increased by 15%.

name: Forestwalk
description: Casting Regrowth increases your movement speed and healing received by 8% for 6 sec.

name: Fount of Strength
description: Your maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.\n\nFrenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.

name: Frantic Momentum
description: Finishing moves have a 3% chance per combo point spent to grant 10% Haste for 6 sec.

name: Gale Winds
description: Increases Typhoon's radius by 20% and its range by 5 yds.

name: Gift of the Wild
description: Mark of the Wild is 100% more effective on yourself.

name: Green Thumb
description: The rate at which Symbiotic Blooms grow is increased by 20%.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.

name: Harmonious Constitution
description: Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.

name: Hunger for Battle
description: When an enemy afflicted by your Rip dies, gain 10 Energy and your damage dealt is increased by 5% for 8 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Hunt Beneath the Open Skies
description: Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.\n\nMoonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.

name: Implant
description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.

name: Improved Barkskin
description: Barkskin's duration is increased by 4 sec.

name: Improved Stampeding Roar
description: Stampeding Roar's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.

name: Incessant Tempest
description: Reduces the cooldown of Typhoon by 5 sec.

name: Infected Wounds
description: Rake damage increased by 30%, and Rake causes an Infected Wound in the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 20% for 12 sec.

name: Instincts of the Claw
description: Ferocious Bite and Maul damage increased by 8%.

name: Killer Instinct
description: Physical damage and Armor increased by 6%.

name: Killing Strikes
description: Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.\n\nYour first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.

name: Lacerating Claws
description: Damage of your bleeds increased by 10%.

name: Lethal Preservation
description: When you remove an effect with Soothe or Remove Corruption, gain a combo point and heal for 4% of your maximum health. If you are at full health an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.

name: Limb from Limb
description: Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next Maul become Ravage.

name: Lingering Healing
description: Rejuvenation's duration is increased by 3 sec.\n\nRegrowth's duration is increased by 3 sec when cast on yourself.

name: Lore of the Grove
description: Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.

name: Lunar Inspiration
description: Moonfire is usable in Cat Form, costs 30 energy, and generates 1 combo point.

name: Lycara's Inspiration
description:
You gain a bonus while in each form inspired by the breadth of your Druidic knowledge:

No Form: 4% Magic Damage
Cat Form: 4% Stamina
Bear Form: 5% Movement Speed
Moonkin Form: 3% Area damage taken reduction

name: Lycara's Teachings
description:
You gain 3% of a stat while in each form:

No Form: Haste
Cat Form: Critical Strike
Bear Form: Versatility
Moonkin Form: Mastery

name: Matted Fur
description: When you use Barkskin or Survival Instincts, absorb 656 damage for 15 sec.

name: Merciless Claws
description: Shred deals 25% increased damage and Swipe deals 25% increased damage against bleeding targets.

name: Moment of Clarity
description: Omen of Clarity now triggers 30% more often, can accumulate up to 2 charges, and increases the damage of your next Shred or Swipe by 15%.

name: Natural Recovery
description: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.

name: Nurturing Instinct
description: Magical damage and healing increased by 6%.

name: Oakskin
description: Survival Instincts and Barkskin reduce damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Omen of Clarity
description: Your auto attacks have a chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Shred or Swipe cost no Energy.

name: Pack's Endurance
description: Stampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.

name: Panther's Guile
description: When Shred or Moonfire generate combo points, they have a 25% chance to generate full combo points.

name: Patient Custodian
description: Your heal over time effects are 6% more effective.

name: Perfectly-Honed Instincts
description: Well-Honed Instincts can trigger up to once every 90 sec.

name: Pouncing Strikes
description: While stealthed, Rake will also stun the target for 4 sec, and deal 60% increased damage for its full duration.\n\nWhile stealthed, Shred deals 60% increased damage, has double the chance to critically strike, and generates 1 additional combo point.

name: Predator
description: Tiger's Fury lasts 5 additional seconds.\n\nYour combo point-generating abilities' direct damage is increased by 40% of your Haste.

name: Primal Fury
description: While in Cat Form, when you critically strike with an attack that generates a combo point, you gain an additional combo point. Damage over time cannot trigger this effect.\n\nMangle critical strike damage increased by 20%.

name: Raging Fury
description: Tiger's Fury lasts 5 additional seconds.

name: Rampancy
description: Symbiotic Blooms have a 20% chance to trigger Bursting Growth every 2 sec at 100% effectiveness.

name: Rampant Ferocity
description: Ferocious Bite also deals 13 damage per combo point spent to all nearby enemies. Spending extra Energy on Ferocious Bite increases damage dealt by up to 100%. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Ravage
description:
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: 13 damage, 6 in an arc
2 points: 26 damage, 12 in an arc
3 points: 38 damage, 18 in an arc
4 points: 52 damage, 24 in an arc
5 points: 65 damage, 30 in an arc

name: Resilient Flourishing
description: Bloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.\n\nWhen a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.

name: Rip and Tear
description: Applying Rip to a target also applies a Tear that deals 20% of the new Rip's damage over 8 sec.

name: Root Network
description: Each active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.\n\nEach active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.

name: Ruthless Aggression
description: Ravage increases your auto-attack speed by 35% for 6 sec.

name: Saber Jaws
description: When you spend extra Energy on Ferocious Bite, the extra damage is increased by 60%.

name: Sabertooth
description: Ferocious Bite deals 15% increased damage.\n\nFor each Combo Point spent, Ferocious Bite's primary target takes 6% increased damage from your Cat Form bleed and other periodic abilities for 4 sec.

name: Savage Fury
description: Tiger's Fury increases your Haste by 10% and Energy recovery rate by 25% for 8 sec.

name: Soul of the Forest
description: Your finishing moves grant 2 Energy per combo point spent and deal 5% increased damage.

name: Starlight Conduit
description: Wrath, Starsurge, and Starfire damage increased by 5%. \n\nStarsurge's cooldown is reduced by 4 sec and its mana cost is reduced by 50%.

name: Strategic Infusion
description: Attacking from Prowl increases the chance for Shred, Rake, and Swipe to critically strike by 8% for 6 sec.\n\nYour periodic heals have a 4% increased chance to critically heal.

name: Strike for the Heart
description: Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

name: Sudden Ambush
description: Finishing moves have a 6% chance per combo point spent to increase the direct damage of your next Rake, Shred, or Swipe by 50% and make it critically strike.

name: Taste for Blood
description: Ferocious Bite deals 16% increased damage and an additional 8% during Tiger's Fury.

name: Tear Down the Mighty
description: The cooldown of Sundering Roar is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Thick Hide
description: Reduces all damage taken by 4%.

name: Thriving Growth
description:
Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Wild Growth, Regrowth, and Efflorescence healing has a chance to cause Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 834 over 6 sec.

Multiple instances of these can overlap.

name: Tiger's Tenacity
description: Tiger's Fury causes your next 3 finishing moves to restore 1 combo point.\n\nTiger's Fury also increases the periodic damage of your bleeds by an additional 10% for their full duration.

name: Tireless Energy
description: Maximum Energy increased by 20 and Energy regeneration increased by 5%.

name: Twin Claw
description: You have a 18% chance to follow up any single target melee ability with a Twin Claw, dealing 121 Physical damage and generating 5 Rage.

name: Twin Sprouts
description: When Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.

name: Unseen Predator
description:
When you Ferocious Bite, you have a 15% chance per combo point spent to flicker to an enemy within 30 yds and deliver an Unseen Attack. Unseen Attack damage is reduced if less than 5 combo points and 50 Energy are spent on Ferocious Bite.

 Unseen Slash
Slash the target, dealing 23 Physical damage and an additional 48 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new Bleed.

 Unseen Swipe
Swipe nearby targets, dealing 65 Physical damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Ursine Vigor
description: For 4 sec after shifting into Bear Form, your health and armor are increased by 15%.

name: Ursoc's Spirit
description: Stamina increased by 4%.\n\nStamina in Bear Form is increased by an additional 5%.

name: Veinripper
description: Rip and Rake last 25% longer.

name: Verdant Heart
description: Frenzied Regeneration and Barkskin increase all healing received by 20%.

name: Vigorous Creepers
description: Bloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.\n\nSymbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.

name: Well-Honed Instincts
description: When you fall below 40% health, you cast Frenzied Regeneration, up to once every 120 sec.

name: Wild Slashes
description: Swipe damage is increased by 40%.

name: Wildpower Surge
description: Mangle grants Feline Potential. When you have 6 stacks, the next time you transform into Cat Form, gain 5 combo points and your next Ferocious Bite or Rip deals 50% increased damage for its full duration.

name: Wildshape Mastery
description:
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.

name: Wildstalker's Power
description: Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.\n\nRejuvenation healing increased by 10%.

name: Halazzi's Fury
description: When $?s102543[Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane][Berserk] ends, you deal $1301600s1% increased damage for $?(s102543&s391548)[${$s2/1000}.2][${$s1/1000}] sec for each combo point spent during $?s102543[Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane][Berserk].

name: Overflowing Power
description:
Go Berserk for $d. While Berserk:

Generate $343216s1 combo $lpoint:points; every $t1 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate $s2 additional combo $lpoint:points;. Finishing moves restore up to $405189u combo points generated over the cap.
